The RL_SCALING_STRATEGY_TEST phase involves balancing prefill pressure, decode tail, KV cache transfer, GPU scheduling, and autoscaling to optimize model performance. Prefill pressure refers to the amount of data that needs to be loaded into the model before execution, ensuring efficient memory usage. The decode tail is the time taken after the model starts processing, which affects the overall latency. KV cache transfer involves transferring key-value pairs between the model and GPU memory, reducing latency. GPU scheduling ensures that resources are allocated optimally to handle the workload, preventing bottlenecks. Autoscaling adjusts the number of GPUs based on the current workload, ensuring scalability without overloading the system.
